statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry)
The diagnosis codes submitted were R55 and I25.10
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
Intermittent arrhythmia is suspected as the underlying cause of the collapse events
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
